# Pixsl Studio

Pixsl Studio offers web design and development services, custom software, and branding for owner-led businesses worldwide. From idea to launched website in two weeks, on a fixed quote, with a working preview you approve before we build.

Website: https://pixsl.pro
Contact: hello@pixsl.pro
Founder: Prabha (reads and replies to every enquiry)

## What we do
- Website design and development: new Signature Websites, rescues and rebuilds of existing sites, and ecommerce stores with catalogue and checkout, on WordPress or Next.js. Mobile-first and search-ready.
- Custom software and apps: client portals, dashboards, booking tools, and internal apps built around how your team works.
- Branding and digital assets: logo, colours, type, and the social and profile assets that make a business recognisable everywhere.
- Website care and hosting: managed hosting, maintenance with a set response window, content and gallery updates, and uptime and page-speed monitoring.

## Pricing
- Signature Website: from about AED 4,000 (roughly USD 1,100), most between AED 4,000 and 5,000.
- Rescue, custom software, ecommerce, and care plans: quoted after a short call.
- Every project starts with a fixed quote. No hourly billing, no surprise invoices.

## Timeline
- Live in 10 to 14 days for a website or rebuild, counted from the day you approve the working preview.

## How we work (MVP-first)
- You approve a real, clickable working preview, not a static mockup, before we build the full site.
- You own everything at launch: domain, code, content, and accounts. No lock-in.

## Where we work
- Remote-first. We build for businesses across the Middle East, the UK, Europe, the US, India, and Southeast Asia.

## Sister studios (separate brands)
- Pixsl Flow: automation and AI agents.
- Pixsl Rank: SEO and visibility.
